spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Bartek Ellingham. Could you tell me what time your High Street branch in York opens?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Bartek. It opens at half past nine on weekdays, and at ten on Saturdays.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And is it open this coming Monday?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, it’ll be open as usual, and I can assure you you’ll be able to get in and get everything sorted there.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, thanks. What time does it close?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: It closes at four thirty on weekdays. On Saturdays it closes at one.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s useful. Do I need to book an appointment for a general enquiry?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You don’t need one for a general enquiry, though you’re welcome to book if you’d prefer. I’m happy to take you through the options.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that’s fine. I’ll just pop in.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Certainly. Just to summarise, the York High Street branch opens at nine thirty on weekdays and ten on Saturdays, and closes at four thirty on weekdays and one on Saturdays. You can go in without an appointment for a general enquiry. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, it does. Thanks for your help.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Bartek. Have a lovely day.
